import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { EMPTY_STRING, FIRST_ARG_INDEX } from '@src/constants';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { cancelApp, confirmApp, previewApp } from '@src/response-apps/skillBook/reset/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';

const buildUsageMd = () => {
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  md.addText('❌ 参数错误');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText('使用方法:');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText('/重制功法 功法ID');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText('/确认重制功法');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText('/取消重制功法');

  return md;
};

export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const uid = e.uid as number;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;
  const text = (e.MessageText || EMPTY_STRING).trim();

  if (/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?取消重制功法$/.test(text)) {
    const result = await cancelApp({ bid, uid, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    md.addText(result.success ? result.message : `❌ ${result.message}`);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '功法重制', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  if (/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?确认重制功法$/.test(text)) {
    const result = await confirmApp({ bid, uid, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });
    const md = Format.createMarkdown();

    if (!result.success) {
      md.addText(`❌ ${result.message}`);
    } else {
      md.addBold('功法重制完成');
      md.addNewline();
      md.addText(result.message);

      if (result.skillBook) {
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`功法：【${result.skillBook.name}】【${result.skillBook.skillType}】`);
      }

      if (result.refundInfo) {
        md.addNewline();
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`返还经验：${result.refundInfo.exp}`);
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`返还灵石：${result.refundInfo.spiritStone}`);
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(`重制等级：${result.refundInfo.upgradeCount} -> 0`);

        if (result.refundInfo.affectedAttrs.length > 0) {
          md.addNewline();
          md.addText(`重制词条：${result.refundInfo.affectedAttrs.join('、')}`);
          md.addNewline();
          md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('整数词条重置为1，百分比词条重置为0.01'));
        }

        if (result.refundInfo.items && result.refundInfo.items.length > 0) {
          md.addNewline();
          md.addNewline();
          md.addText('返还残页');
          md.addNewline();

          for (const item of result.refundInfo.items) {
            md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText(`${item.name} x${item.quantity}（${item.expValue}经验/个）`));
          }
        }
      }
    }

    const footer = result.success && result.skillBook ? [{ label: '查看功法', command: `/查看功法 ${result.skillBook.id}` }] : undefined;

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '功法重制', content: md, footer }));

    return;
  }

  const resetText = text.replace(/^(!|！|\/|#|＃)?重制功法\s*/, '').trim();
  const args = resetText ? resetText.split(/\s+/) : [];
  const skillBookIdStr = args[FIRST_ARG_INDEX];

  if (!skillBookIdStr) {
    const md = buildUsageMd();

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '功法重制', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const skillBookId = Number(skillBookIdStr);

  if (!Number.isFinite(skillBookId) || skillBookId <= 0) {
    const md = buildUsageMd();

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '功法重制', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const result = await previewApp({ bid, uid, skillBookId, request: createBackendRequestContext(e) });
  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  if (!result.success) {
    md.addText(`❌ ${result.message}`);

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '功法重制', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  const pending = result.pendingData;

  if (!pending || !result.refundInfo || !result.skillBook) {
    md.addText('❌ 功法重制预览生成失败');

    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '功法重制', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  md.addBold('功法重制预览');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`功法：【${pending.skillBookName}】【${pending.gradeName}】【${pending.realmName}】`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`类型：${pending.skillType}`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`重制等级：${pending.upgradeCount} -> 0`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`返还经验：${result.refundInfo.exp}（升级消耗的80%）`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText(`返还灵石：${result.refundInfo.spiritStone}（升级消耗的70%）`);
  md.addNewline();
  md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('经验将按功法残页返还，不足最低残页面额的尾差会舍弃'));
  md.addText('重制词条');
  md.addNewline();

  if (result.refundInfo.affectedAttrs.length > 0) {
    md.addBlockquote(
      Format.createMarkdown()
        .addText(`${result.refundInfo.affectedAttrs.join('、')}`)
        .addNewline()
        .addText('整数词条将降为1，百分比词条将降为0.01')
    );
  } else {
    md.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('无激活词条，仅重置等级'));
  }

  md.addNewline();
  md.addNewline();
  md.addText('确认指令：/确认重制功法');

  const footer = [
    { label: '确认重制', command: '/确认重制功法' },
    { label: '取消', command: '/取消重制功法' }
  ];

  void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '功法重制', content: md, footer }));
});
